messages:
maria_cs: @sophia_hf thanks for sending the intake form — looping in SE + safety to scope the Harborfield multilang summarizer + reranker request. quick TL;DR from customer: private deployment (VPC), PHI data, HSM for keys, aim for 150 reqs/s 256-token avg, model family: mix of open 13b variants + a custom fine-tune. needs safety evals and a plan for rollback/renewal.
sophia_hf: hi all! correct — we want an on-prem like setup in our VPC. primary concerns: PHI handling, latency under 300ms p95, and deterministic output for audits. do you need sample data?
maria_cs: yes sample prompts + a small eval set would help. kevin, can you advise infra/quantization tradeoffs?
kevin_se: yup. for 13b variants on our dedicated fleet we can hit ~180 reqs/s with q4_0 quant on T4+s if you accept slightly higher tokenization variance. for strict PHI isolation recommend Dedicated or Private with KMS/HSM. also we need the size of the evaluation corpus (number of docs, avg length) and a small prompt bank for quality regression tests.
sophia_hf: eval corpus ~25k docs, avg 400 tokens, mostly clinical notes + short consults. prompt bank ~200 prompts across 8 intents (summarize, redact, extract).
anya_safety: thanks. safety asks: provide the prompt bank + 500 red-team prompts targeting PHI leakage, and a privacy-preserving sampling plan (no raw PHI in S3). we will run: 1) red-team simulations, 2) hallucination suite, 3) PII/PHI leakage scanner, 4) prompt-injection attack matrix. share any compliance artifacts (BAA) if needed.
derek_am: tagging commercial — heads up on renewal risk: if this is a new private contract we should surface MSRP upsell vs hosted. Sophia, do you have budget window and expected go-live date?
sophia_hf: target go-live = +8 weeks. budget is under review but we prefer committed capacity if unit costs are predictable.
kevin_se: for rollout plan: phase 1 = safety eval + small canary on Dedicated (10% traffic) -> 2 weeks of monitoring + quality evals -> phase 2 = full traffic on Dedicated/Private. canary criteria: <0.5% PHI leakage, red-team pass thresholds, p95 latency <300ms.
anya_safety: deliverables from safety: eval rubric, test harness (we'll provide datasets mask-tooling), red-team report, mitigation plan (prompt-level filters + output sanitizer). we need to know if Harborfield requires HSM-backed signing of logs for audit.
sophia_hf: yes HSM signing required for audit trails.
maria_cs: noted. i'll capture action items and schedule a 30m kickoff with Harborfield + SE + Safety tomorrow.
kevin_se: can you drop the minimal infra config we need? I suggest: - model: open-13b-v1 (quant profile q4_0), fallback: open-7b-compat - capacity: 12 GPUs (dedicated pool) - traffic shaping: continuous batching 64ms target - storage: customer VPC S3 + no-raw-data policy
maria_cs: copied. sophia, we'll send a one-pager with these infra recs and the evaluation checklist.
sophia_hf: great — pls include the audit log format and expected SLA.
derek_am: I'll draft commercial terms options (reserved vs committed usage) and run pricing scenarios.
deploy-bot: ticket created: CS-8291 Harborfield multilang summarizer + reranker intake. assigned: kevin_se, anya_safety, maria_cs.
maria_cs: action items: 1) sophia to upload red-team prompts + sample eval set (by EOD Fri) 2) kevin to produce infra cost estimate and canary plan (48h) 3) anya to draft eval rubric and red-team matrix (72h) 4) derek to prepare pricing options (72h). I'll schedule kickoff once uploads are in. :calendar: :thumbsup:
sophia_hf: I'll upload the datasets to the secure intake bucket and share ACLs. thanks everyone! :wave:
